title: Smart Branching & Deployment Workflow — V1/V2 Staging Pipeline
description: Introduce a branch-driven deployment pipeline where dev branch deploys Portfolio V1 to Vercel (staging) and staging branch deploys Portfolio V2 to Cloudflare (testing). This PRD defines the branch strategy, CI/CD workflows, environment promotion, and quality gates that make every future prompt operation aware of which environment it targets.

currentBranches.dev: Active development branch, currently checked out
currentBranches.main: Production-ready branch, currently serves as the release target

currentDeployments.v1: Portfolio V1 lives at portfolio-v1/ — has vercel.json and wrangler.jsonc (dual deploy ready)
currentDeployments.v2: Portfolio V2 lives at portfolio-v2/ — has wrangler.jsonc (Cloudflare only)

context.goal: dev → Vercel (V1 staging), staging → Cloudflare (V2 testing), main → production gate
context.sharedCMS: Sanity project nl0qw78w, dataset production — both deployments read from same Sanity source
context.motivation: Eliminate manual deployment steps. Every push to dev automatically stages V1 on Vercel. Every push to staging automatically tests V2 on Cloudflare. main is the production gate with required checks before merge.

dev.description: Every push to dev deploys V1 to Vercel preview. This is the working staging environment where all features land first.

staging.purpose: V2 integration testing on Cloudflare edge
staging.description: Every push to staging deploys V2 to Cloudflare Workers preview. Used for integration testing of the new stack (React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn registry).

main.purpose: Production releases for both V1 and V2
triggers: PR merge from dev or staging
main.description: Production deployments. V1 deploys to namias.tech on Vercel. V2 deploys to v2.namias.tech on Cloudflare. Requires all checks to pass and manual approval.

flow.developer: Push to dev → auto-deploys V1 to Vercel staging
flow.integration: Merge dev → staging → auto-deploys V2 to Cloudflare testing
flow.production: Merge staging → main → manual approval → deploys both to production
flow.hotfix: Branch from main → fix → PR to main + cherry-pick to dev

epics.title: Branch Protection & Rules
epics.description: Configure GitHub branch protection rules for dev, staging, and main to enforce quality gates before merge.

stories.title: Create staging branch from dev
stories.description: Create the staging branch as a copy of dev. This becomes the V2 testing branch.

details.initialContent: Same as dev at creation time

stories.title: Configure dev branch protection
stories.description: Protect dev branch — require PR for merge, require status checks (lint, typecheck, test), allow force push only for admin.

stories.title: Configure staging branch protection
stories.description: Protect staging branch — require PR for merge, require status checks (lint, typecheck, test, build), allow force push only for admin.

stories.title: Configure main branch protection
stories.description: Protect main branch — require PR, require ALL status checks, require 2 reviews, no force push, no deletes.

epics.title: Dev → Vercel (V1 Staging) Pipeline
epics.description: Auto-deploy Portfolio V1 to Vercel on every push to dev branch. Includes quality gates, build verification, and preview URL generation.

stories.title: Create dev-deploy-v1.yml workflow
stories.description: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on push to dev. Runs quality checks, builds V1, and deploys to Vercel.

stories.title: Create Vercel dev project
stories.description: Create a separate Vercel project for dev deployments. This keeps staging isolated from production.

stories.title: Configure Vercel dev environment variables
stories.description: Set all required env vars in the Vercel dev project dashboard.

stories.title: Add Vercel commit status check
stories.description: Configure Vercel to report deployment status as a GitHub commit status. This blocks merge if deployment fails.

stories.title: Add deploy notification step
stories.description: After successful Vercel deployment, post a comment on the dev branch commit with the preview URL.

epics.title: Staging → Cloudflare (V2 Testing) Pipeline
epics.description: Auto-deploy Portfolio V2 to Cloudflare Workers on every push to staging branch. Includes quality gates, OpenNext build, and preview URL generation.

stories.title: Create staging-deploy-v2.yml workflow

stories.description: Deploy an initial version of the V2 worker to Cloudflare. This creates the worker binding for staging.

stories.title: Configure Cloudflare staging environment variables
stories.description: Set all required env vars in the Cloudflare Workers dashboard for the staging worker.

stories.title: Add staging worker routes
stories.description: Configure Cloudflare routes for the staging worker to handle staging domain traffic.

stories.title: Add Playwright smoke tests to staging pipeline
stories.description: After deployment, run a subset of Playwright tests against the staging URL to verify basic functionality.

epics.title: Main → Production Gate
epics.description: Production deployment workflow triggered on merge to main. Requires all quality gates, dual deployment, and post-deploy verification.

stories.title: Create production-deploy.yml workflow
stories.description: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on push to main (after PR merge). Deploys V1 to Vercel production and V2 to Cloudflare production.

details.trigger: push to main (after PR merge from dev or staging)

stories.title: Create production environment in GitHub
stories.description: Create GitHub environments for production deployments with required reviewers.

stories.title: Configure production DNS
stories.description: Set up DNS records for production domains.

stories.title: Add Sanity webhook dual-targeting
stories.description: Configure Sanity webhooks to trigger revalidation on both production deployments.

epics.title: PR Validation Pipeline
epics.description: Validate PRs targeting dev, staging, or main. Only run checks relevant to the changed portfolio.

stories.description: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on pull_request. Detects which portfolio changed and runs appropriate checks.

steps: dorny/paths-filter to detect portfolio-v1/** and portfolio-v2/** changes
post validation summary as PR comment

stories.title: Add path-based job filtering
stories.description: Use dorny/paths-filter or similar to detect which files changed and only run relevant validation jobs.

stories.title: Add PR preview deployments
stories.description: Auto-deploy preview environments for PRs targeting dev (Vercel) or staging (Cloudflare).

epics.title: Smart Prompt Integration
epics.description: Make every agent prompt aware of the current branch and environment. Agents should know which deployment they are targeting and what quality gates apply.

stories.title: Create DEPLOY_ENV.md context file
stories.description: Auto-generated file that agents read to understand the current deployment context. Updated by CI workflows.

stories.title: Add environment-aware npm scripts
stories.description: Add scripts that are aware of the deployment environment.

stories.title: Update AGENTS.md with deployment context
stories.description: Add a Deployment Pipeline section to AGENTS.md so agents understand the branch → environment mapping.

sections: Branch Strategy: dev (Vercel staging) → staging (Cloudflare testing) → main (production)
Which environment am I in? Read DEPLOY_ENV.md

stories.title: Add deployment skill
stories.description: Create a skill that agents can load to understand the deployment pipeline, run deployments, and check deployment status.

commands: deploy:status — check current deployment state for both V1 and V2
deploy:dev — deploy V1 to Vercel dev
deploy:staging — deploy V2 to Cloudflare staging
deploy:production — deploy both to production (requires approval)
deploy:rollback:v1 — rollback V1 to previous Vercel deployment
deploy:rollback:v2 — rollback V2 to previous Cloudflare deployment

risks.risk: Branch confusion — developers push to wrong branch
risks.mitigation: Branch protection rules, DEPLOY_ENV.md context file, clear AGENTS.md documentation

risks.risk: Vercel and Cloudflare deployment race conditions
risks.mitigation: Concurrency groups in workflows, sequential deployment on main (V1 first, then V2)
Unified .env.example with per-environment sections, validation step in CI

risks.risk: Staging branch diverging too far from dev
risks.mitigation: Weekly auto-sync workflow (dev → staging), PR-based merge required

risks.risk: OpenNext build failures in staging pipeline
risks.mitigation: Build verification step before deploy, --dangerouslyUseUnsupportedNextVersion flag

risks.risk: Production deploy blocked by a single failing check
risks.mitigation: Rollback workflow available, manual override via workflow_dispatch for emergencies

dev: Push to dev auto-deploys V1 to Vercel within 5 minutes
Preview URL is accessible at dev.namias.tech
All quality gates pass before deployment
Deployment status reported as commit status
staging: Push to staging auto-deploys V2 to Cloudflare within 8 minutes
Preview URL is accessible at staging.namias.tech
Playwright smoke tests pass against staging URL
production: Merge to main deploys both V1 and V2 within 15 minutes
All quality gates pass before deployment
Sanity webhooks trigger revalidation on both
smartPrompt: DEPLOY_ENV.md exists and is auto-updated by CI
Agents can read DEPLOY_ENV.md to know current deployment target
Rollback workflows can be triggered by agents

nonGoals: Replace existing deployment configs (vercel.json, wrangler.jsonc) — enhance them
Implement auto-merge for PRs — human approval stays required
Build a custom deployment dashboard — use Vercel + Cloudflare dashboards
Multi-region deployment — single region (sin1 for Vercel, default for CF) for now
Canary or blue-green deployments — simple atomic deployments for both
openQuestions: Should staging sync from dev automatically on a schedule, or only via PR?
Should we use Vercel preview deployments for PRs targeting dev, or only for the dev branch itself?
Do we need a separate Cloudflare worker for staging, or use wrangler --env staging?
Should production deploy require 2 reviews or just 1 with the deploy workflow approval?
Should we add Slack/Discord notifications for deployment events?
